title: Rep. Keith Self addresses historical figures and national security issues in recent posts
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives, posted several statements on March 30, 2026, addressing topics ranging from historical figures to law enforcement and foreign organizations.
In a tweet posted at 18:31 UTC, Self highlighted the contributions of Polly Cooper of the Oneida Indian Nation during the American Revolution. He wrote, “As we move closer to celebrating America’s 250th, it’s important to remember the unsung heroes who helped shape our nation’s story. One of those heroes is Polly Cooper of the Oneida Indian Nation. During the brutal winter of 1777–78 at Valley Forge, General George Washington’s”.
Later that day at 19:28 UTC, Self addressed an incident involving graffiti targeting federal immigration officers. He stated, “Spray-painting ‘kill your local ICE agent’ isn’t protest — it’s a direct call to murder and a federal crime. ICE agents are American heroes, putting their lives on the line daily to remove illegal aliens and make our communities safer. I call on Democrats to disavow this”.
At 20:50 UTC on March 30, Self called for legislative action against two organizations. He tweeted, “CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood must be federally designated as foreign terrorist organizations. The Sharia-Free America Caucus has the bills to do it. Let’s get it done.”
Keith Self was elected to Congress after defeating Sandeep Srivastava in both the 2022 and 2024 general elections with significant margins.
